description: BASINS 4.5 is an actively supported watershed and water-quality modelling suite distributed by the US Environmental Protection Agency. Its GIS interface combines national environmental layers, user-supplied spatial and time-series data, assessment tools and plug-ins for models including HSPF, SWAT, SWMM, AQUATOX and WASP. A user defines a watershed, loads source and local data, prepares model inputs and runs or compares the linked models. Outputs include maps, pollutant loading estimates and water-quality or runoff series for the selected catchment and simulation period. Geographic coverage is principally the United States, though a user can supply a local study area. EPA publishes a free Windows installer and manuals; version 4.5 is its only currently supported release. The RESPEC GitHub source has no README or explicit redistribution licence, so this draft claims public use of EPA's distributed software, not unrestricted source reuse. A limitation is that installed plug-ins and local calibration data are needed for credible results. BASINS supports watershed pollution, drainage and flood-planning studies. The catalogue's model-epa-swmm is a distinct linked stormwater engine. No installer, plug-in archive or watershed dataset was downloaded.
